title: Payment Acceptance and Autopay Terms — Apartment Home Lease
content:
These terms govern which payments are accepted on an Apartment Home Lease ledger and how autopay enrollment takes effect.

## Terms

**1. When payments are accepted.** Payments are accepted on a lease only while it is approved, active, in default, eviction filed or vacated, as the lease record shows. A closed lease accepts no payment here; any balance left at closing is carried and collected under the Security Deposit Account charter.

**2. Move-in funds.** Funds due at move-in are accepted only in the floor plan's instruments accepted for move-in funds.

**3. Certified funds only.** While the lease is on certified funds only and the payment date is on or before the last date of the restriction, only the floor plan's certified funds instruments are accepted, and ACH autopay cannot be enrolled.

**4. After a delinquency notice.** Once a delinquency notice has been served, a payment smaller than the full amount demanded is accepted only when the floor plan accepts partial payment after a notice, or when the payment is the down payment or an installment of a signed payment plan.

**5. After an eviction filing.** Once an eviction case is filed, only a payment of the full balance due is accepted.

**6. Order within a group.** Within each group of charges, charges are paid oldest charge date first, and within one date rent before recurring fees.

**7. Autopay timing.** An autopay enrollment or cancellation takes effect for the next rent due date that is at least 3 calendar days after the request; a request made later takes effect for the due date after that.

## Autopay timing — boundary cases (hypothetical dates, rent due on the 1st)

| Request date | Calendar days to 1 April | Takes effect for |
|---|---|---|
| 27 March | 5 | 1 April |
| 29 March | 3 | 1 April |
| 30 March | 2 | 1 May |

## Acceptance at a glance

| Lease situation | Payment offered | Accepted |
|---|---|---|
| Closed | any | No |
| On certified funds only, payment dated within the restriction | an instrument that is not one of the certified funds instruments | No |
| Notice served, floor plan does not accept partial payment | less than the full amount demanded, not part of a signed plan | No |
| Notice served | down payment of a signed payment plan | Yes |
| Eviction filed | less than the full balance due | No |

## Clause no longer in force

The clause applying every accepted payment to the open charges of the lease in the allocation order of the community's state is no longer in force. That clause read the order recorded with this rule: in every state other than Colorado, non-rent charges first and rent charges second; in Colorado, rent charges first and non-rent charges second. It is reproduced so an older ledger can be read, not to be applied.

superseded_clauses: Every accepted payment is applied to the open charges of the lease in the allocation order of the community's state: allocation_order_default, unless allocation_order_overrides names the state.
